Spirit actual state: onHit adds random3..6 through base addFrozenDuration(get+amount), overridden watched-field setter. isFrozen means positive only, no clamp/overflow safety. isImmobile is frozen OR buildup>0. aiStep calls superclass first, decrements positive buildup, then frozen branch zeroes delta movement and subtracts1; mutually exclusive else spends remainingLife and removes KILLED when<=0. The final1-to0 frozen update still preserves life; next update may spend life. Buildup alone blocks immobility predicate but does not pause life. No stored prior velocity/AI restoration; no side guard in this aiStep.

This is actual state producer/consumer source, not proof native tracking packet delivery or rendered pixels. Buildup is not asserted to use an overridden watched accessor merely because a watcher is declared.

Beam ambient effects do not prove freeze success. Client-visible removal smoke/death sound is emitted for remove reasons generally, not a strict killed receipt. Frozen zero ends frozen render predicate but buildup may still block mobility. EntanglingPlayers set has append/get and no local expiry removal, support context0.

full_chain.observation: Own-item canDrain compares exact simulated amount. Otherwise canConsume checks only nonempty simulated drainFromOthers, not requested total. drainFromOthers cumulatively adds drained, but subtracts cumulative amount from remaining on each iteration, and its final nonempty&&empty condition is impossible. consume EXECUTE only for null player or noncreative server player; creative/client SIMULATE. throwNecromancersHead constructs on either side, sets mobType and shoots/adds only server; addFreshEntity return ignored. mobType field/setter unused by spawnSwarm, which always constructs ControlledZombie. Head.onHit acts only ENTITY, not observing, server. Calls target.hurt(thrown(owner),0) before qualifications and ignores result. Then requires ServerPlayer owner, hit not owner, hit LivingEntity to spawnSwarm; otherwise discard. No alive gate, source immunity result gate or final rejection receipt. Block/client/already-observing hits have no local action in override; no inherited impact behavior claimed.

spawnSwarm loops random3..4, constructs each child; canAttackType override true. Copies necromancer position, moves randomXZ, calls Core EntityHelpers.spawnEntity. Helper calls Forge onFinalizeSpawn; non-null SpawnGroupData triggers world.addFreshEntity but ignores its boolean and returns true. Thus observables list means helper-qualified, not proved added entity. Regardless helper result, qualifying child then receives setTarget(original hit entity) and TTL200. After loop head stores target and enters observer mode even if list empty. No child owner UUID/reference set; target may later change via native goals. No guarantee actual mob melee since native goals/caller not expanded and MeleeAttackGoal was put in targetSelector.

setObserverMode sets observing=true, motion0, invisible=true. Head.remove delegates to super only when !observing, vetoing any reason while flagtrue. Actual tick first super.tick then, only observing and server and efficientTick(level,10), scans list. Shared helper uses random.nextInt(10)==0 (no parameters), not every10th tick. Dead child removed from list; if original target not alive, each living child discarded and removed. When list empty, clears observing then calls remove(DISCARDED), now permitted. Target death cleanup is sampled, not instant. No explicit owner-alive, distance, dimension or owner-held-item gate. Motion set once, no noGravity flag or pre-super stop, so not guaranteed stationary observer.
